# Azure AI Foundry / Microsoft Foundry — captured 2026-08-09

## SOURCE DRIFT — IMPORTANT
The sources.json changelog URL (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/whats-new) now
canonically resolves to **learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry-classic/openai/whats-new** — the
*classic* Azure OpenAI page. Its newest section is **May 2026** (GPT Realtime 2.0 / Translate /
Whisper concept articles) and it carries **no agent-platform content at all**.

The live docs changelog for the new portal is
**https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/whats-new-foundry** (redirected from
/azure/ai-foundry/whats-new-azure-ai-foundry). Newest published month: **June 2026**
(ms.date 2026-07-08, updated_at 2026-07-15). Because sources.json points at the classic page, this
whole stream has been invisible to the monitor — the June 2026 wave below had never been reported.

## June 2026 wave (backlog recovery — reported 2026-08-09)
- Toolboxes + tool search: a versioned, first-class toolbox resource exposing tools to hosted agents
  through a single managed MCP consumer endpoint. Tool types: MCP, web search, Azure AI Search, code
  interpreter, file search, OpenAPI, agent-to-agent (A2A), browser automation, Fabric IQ, Work IQ,
  tool search, skills. Per-tool `require_approval` (incl. "never"); guardrail (RAI policy) attachable
  per toolbox; RBAC over developer, agent and end-user identities.
  agents/how-to/tools/toolbox , agents/how-to/tools/tool-search , agents/concepts/toolbox-overview
- Routines (preview): trigger→agent automation native to a Foundry project. Trigger types timer,
  recurring (cron), and event (`github_issue`, via a Foundry-provisioned GitHub connector connection
  in the account's connector namespace). Carries input, lifecycle state and run history. A hosted
  agent can also schedule ITSELF via a built-in reminder tool exposed through a toolbox.
  agents/concepts/routines , agents/how-to/use-routines
- Fabric IQ tool (preview): agents delegate natural-language questions to the Microsoft Fabric IQ
  workload — ontology (entity types, properties, relationships, OneLake bindings), Fabric data
  agents, and Power BI semantic models, with an NL2Ontology layer. Delegated user auth via BYO Entra
  app or managed OAuth connection. Docs warn data may leave the Azure compliance boundary.
  agents/how-to/tools/fabric-iq
- Work IQ tool (preview): connects Foundry agents to Microsoft 365 (mail, calendar, files, chats).
  agents/how-to/tools/work-iq
- Memory in Foundry Agent Service (preview) + Memory Store API: managed long-term memory stores.
  Three extracted types — user profile, chat summary, procedural — all enabled by default. Item-level
  CRUD, store-level default TTL, direct remember/forget commands, scope model (max 100 scopes/store,
  10,000 memories/scope). Docs call out prompt injection and memory corruption as explicit risks.
  No VNet support for memory stores.
  agents/concepts/what-is-memory , agents/how-to/memory-usage
- Agent optimizer (preview): closed-loop evaluate→mutate→rank service that rewrites instructions,
  skills (SKILL.md), tool/parameter descriptions and model selection, then promotes a winning
  candidate to a new agent version. Warning in docs: during optimization the agent is invoked against
  every task in the dataset, so external tool calls really execute.
  agents/concepts/agent-optimizer-overview
- Observability: Trace Replay (preview) and convert-agent-traces-to-evaluation-datasets (preview).
  observability/how-to/trace-agent-replay , observability/how-to/traces-to-dataset
- Publish agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Teams, including from inside a virtual
  network.  agents/how-to/publish-copilot , agents/how-to/publish-copilot-virtual-network
- Deploy and use Claude models in Microsoft Foundry.
- Voice Live 2026-06-01-preview API reference.

## Docs hub (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/, updated_at 2026-06-26) — unchanged
Sections: Foundry Agent Service, Foundry IQ, Foundry Models, Foundry Tools, Observability and
evaluation (incl. AI Red Teaming Agent preview), Foundry Control Plane, Foundry Local, Foundry MCP
Server, Microsoft Agent 365.

## API reference (foundry/openai/reference, updated_at 2026-06-24) — unchanged
Control plane latest preview 2025-07-01-preview / GA 2025-06-01; data plane v1 preview / v1.

Updated: 2026-08-09 — no NEW August activity; the June 2026 wave is a backlog recovery caused by the
sources.json URL pointing at the classic page.
